job.title: Full Stack Engineer
job.description:
Role: Full Stack Engineer
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time




Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Indicative range: $100,000 – $160,000 (USD equivalent), plus benefits.




Role Overview

We are hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build features end-to-end across our web application. The role spans frontend, backend, and the database underneath — partnering with product and design to ship things that work and scale.




Key Responsibilities

- Build user-facing features end-to-end, from UI through API to database

- Write clean, maintainable code with appropriate test coverage

- Design APIs and data models that hold up as the product grows

- Conduct code reviews and contribute to engineering practices

- Diagnose and resolve production issues across the stack

- Partner with product and design on feasibility and trade-offs




Required Skills and Qualifications

- 3+ years building production web applications end-to-end

- Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern frontend framework (React, Vue, or similar)

- Backend experience with Node.js, Python, Ruby, or Go

- Experience with relational databases and writing efficient SQL

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and CI/CD

- Solid testing discipline and Git workflow experience




What You'll Bring

- Curiosity to dig into systems and turn findings into shipped improvements

- Strong written communication and ability to explain technical decisions

- A test-and-learn mindset; you ship fast, measure, and iterate

- Comfort working asynchronously across time zones




What We Offer

- Fully remote, flexible work hours

- Performance-based bonus structure

- Annual learning & development stipend

- Health and wellness benefits (varies by location)

- Opportunity to work on high-scale, real-world impact projects




Equal Opportunity Statement

This is an equal opportunity role. Applications are welcomed from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, skills, and demonstrated ability.

Company Description Commotion is building an AI-native operating system designed to power the future of business across customer experience, operations, and workforce transformation. Its unified platform brings together omnichannel customer experience, real-time Voice AI, and enterprise-grade AI Workers to transform conversations and workflows at scale. By modernizing how organizations communicate and automate, Commotion enables more efficient, intelligent, and scalable operations. The company focuses on defining the next generation of customer experience and employee enablement. Team members join a fast-evolving environment where AI is central to product innovation and impact.
Role Description The Senior FDE, Full Stack App Development role is a full-time, remote position responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable web applications that power Commotion’s AI-native platform. Experience with cloud platforms and DevOps practices (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure; containers, CI/CD, monitoring, and logging).

Background in building products that integrate AI, data, or real-time communication systems is highly beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

job.title: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER - ENTERPRISE AI PLATFORMS (GEMINI)
job.description:
FULLSTACK DEVELOPER ENTERPRISE AI PLATFORMS (GEMINI)

Location: Remote | Type: Full-time / Contract

About Newpage Solutions

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations including pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders to build transformative AI and data-driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centred practices.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. We foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.

Your Mission

We are hiring a Fullstack Developer who knows the Gemini platform from the inside how Gemini Enterprise is administered, how agents, data connectors, extensions and Gems are built, registered, scoped and distributed, and how access and permissions actually flow through them.

You will be embedded with a large enterprise client as part of a small engineering pod, alongside engineers who own other enterprise AI platforms. You will own the path by which new data connectors, agents and skills reach users: from intake through access group creation, identity provider synchronisation, connector registration, per-tool permission scoping, testing, documentation and closure with the requester. You will review third-party components for security and quality before release, and replace manual console work with automated, repeatable pipelines.

This is not an administration role. Most of your time goes into building: the backend services, data mappings and integrations that wire the platform into the client's systems, and the internal tooling that gives platform owners visibility and control over how AI capabilities are being used. You should be as strong in the backend APIs, identity, data, infrastructure as code as you are in the UI.

You won't wait for a refined backlog or a separate platform team. You will take a vague request, work out what is actually needed, build it, and stand it up in production yourself. This is a builder role for engineers who combine solid fullstack fundamentals with a deep, practical understanding of the Gemini platform and its extension model.

What You'll Do

Build & Integrate


Design and build the backend services, APIs and data mappings that connect Gemini to enterprise systems identity, data sources, ticketing and the connectors in between.
Build internal tooling and admin interfaces (React / Next.js over Python or TypeScript backends) that give platform owners visibility into usage and control over which capabilities are available to whom.
Build or integrate agents and extensions for the client's own use cases Agent Designer, ADK, Gemini CLI extensions, or LLM-powered services and agents on whichever orchestration framework fits (LangGraph, Google ADK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar), integrating models through APIs, tool calling / MCP and structured outputs and register them in Gemini Enterprise so the right people can use them.
Take a vague request from a business or platform owner, work out what is actually needed, ship a working version quickly, and harden what survives contact with real users.


Own Connector & Agent Requests End to End


Own data connector, agent and skill requests for the enterprise Gemini platform from intake through to closure with the requester.
Create access groups and manage identity provider synchronisation (SSO / SCIM with Okta, Entra ID or Google Cloud Identity) so access follows existing team and group structures.
Register connectors and data stores and apply per-tool permission scoping, granting only the access each capability needs.
Test each connector and agent before release, document what it does and how to use it, and close the loop with the requester.


Configure, Distribute & Review Platform Capabilities


Configure and distribute agents, skills, extensions and Gems to the right audience enterprise-wide, group-scoped or on request with a clear understanding of the scoping controls and what each one actually gates.
Conduct security and quality reviews of third-party and externally authored agents, extensions and connectors before release: dependencies, bundled scripts, and exposure to prompt injection or data exfiltration.
Define remediation or approval decisions and document them so the standard is repeatable.


Automate Provisioning


Automate setup, registration and provisioning through CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform) in place of manual console configuration.
Build parameterised deployments across development, staging and production environments.
Turn recurring manual requests into reusable, version-controlled automation.


What You Bring


5+ years building production fullstack applications in Python and TypeScript APIs, integrations and modern web frameworks (FastAPI, Node / Fastify, React / Next.js). You are backend-strong: data mappings, integration plumbing and wiring systems together is where you spend most of your time, not just the UI.
Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Gemini platform: Gemini Enterprise administration (data connectors and data stores, agent registration, end-user feature controls, IdP-synced groups and access) and the Gemini API, plus Gemini for Google Workspace (Gems and admin controls) where it is in use. You know how capabilities are packaged, scoped and distributed and where the sharp edges are. Familiarity with Vertex AI and the agent stack (ADK, Agent Runtime, Agent Registry, A2A) is useful rather than essential.
Hands-on experience with Gemini function calling / tool use and MCP servers, including tool permissions and capability scoping.
Hands-on experience building agents or LLM integrations with at least one orchestration framework (LangGraph, Google ADK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar), and comfortable switching the team's framework is not fixed.
Security-minded reviewing of code and AI components: dependency analysis, script review, and a practical understanding of prompt injection and data exfiltration risks.
CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Cloud Build or similar) and infrastructure as code with Terraform across AWS, Google Cloud or Azure, including parameterised multi-environment deployments.
Structured, disciplined use of AI-assisted development (Gemini CLI, Claude Code or similar) with review, not on autopilot.
Clear written communication, and the confidence to reframe a vague request into something concrete rather than wait for someone else to define it.
Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.


Bonus Skills / Experience


Working knowledge of a second enterprise AI platform Claude (Claude Enterprise, Claude Code), Microsoft Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock or Azure AI Foundry. A strong plus: you will be expected to provide cover across platforms.
Background in AppSec, supply-chain security or security review processes.
Experience in pharma, life sciences or other regulated industries.
Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Terraform Associate).
A recent public trail of built things GitHub, side projects, OSS contributions, or writing about building with AI.


What We Offer

At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:


A people-first culture supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
Smart, purposeful collaboration work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
Balance that lasts we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
Room to grow opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
Meaningful rewards competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential.


Ready to Apply?

Let's build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to shubhi.tiwari@newpage.io with any questions.

This is a contract-to-hire position

Experience: 8+ Years

Job Description:

We are looking for a strong Tech Lead with 8+ years of hands-on  development experience, with expertise in React.js, Node.js and Python. 




The candidate should be comfortable leading technical implementation while remaining hands-on with coding, architecture and problem-solving.

Lead the design, development and delivery of scalable web applications.
Hands-on development using React.js, Node.js and Python.
Define application architecture, coding standards and technical best practices.
Review code, troubleshoot complex technical issues and ensure quality delivery.
Lead and mentor developers and conduct technical discussions/code reviews.
Work closely with product managers, clients and engineering teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Design and integrate REST APIs, third-party APIs and databases.
Identify performance, scalability and security improvements.

8+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong hands-on expertise in React.js.
Strong experience with Node.js and backend development.
Good hands-on experience in Python.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs and databases.
Experience with application architecture and scalable systems.
Good understanding of Git, CI/CD and cloud environments.
Strong debugging, problem-solving and communication skills.
Experience leading a development team or taking technical ownership of projects.

Preferred:

Experience with AWS/Azure/GCP.
Experience with Docker and microservices.
Exposure to AI/GenAI integrations is an advantage.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

A hands-on technical leader who can architect, code, review, mentor and deliver—not someone limited to people management.
